[color=#666666]last updated 09-08-2002[/color]

Hi! I'm Kat. I live in Maple Grove and I spend way too much time on TrailTalk. This page is mostly trail photos and links to my friends' pages.
[i]this page is best viewed in Internet Explorer 5[/i]

22, junior at Western. I work weekends at the video store on 3rd. I drive a blue Civic (yes, the one in the TrailTalk photos).

I hike Cascade Ridge almost every month — it's 40 minutes from my parents' place. If you're ever in Maple Grove, the diner next to the Safeway has the best fries in the county.
